analyticsHint: Online sales insights, stock forecasts and AI questions for the owner.
analyticsOffline: Connect to the network and make sure the analytics server is available.
analyticsSignIn: Sign in to your analytics owner account.
analyticsServer: Use an HTTPS server address, or localhost for development.
analyticsRequest: The analytics request could not be completed.
analyticsNoStore: No stores have been assigned to this account.
analyticsAlreadyLinked: Disconnect the current store before connecting this POS to another store.
analyticsAccountHint: Use your separate cloud owner account. Your session stays in the desktop main process and ends when you lock or close the POS.
analyticsPOSConnection: This POS and your mobile app
analyticsLinkHint: Connect this POS to the selected store to upload sales and stock summaries. Your mobile app uses the same server address and cloud owner account. Billing continues offline.
analyticsOnlineOnly: These analytics need the configured server. Checkout, inventory and local reports continue to work offline.
analyticsForecastHint: Forecasts use observed unit sales, which can understate demand during stockouts. Review reorder explanations before purchasing; no orders are placed automatically.
localData: Your data stays on this computer
loginHint: Sign in to start your day at Ajith Super Market.
changePasswordHint: Choose your password and an approval PIN before you continue.
scanSearch: Scan a barcode or search products…
searchHint: Search by barcode, English or Sinhala name
quickHint: Tap to add to the bill
emptyCartHint: Select a product on the left or scan a barcode to start the bill.
customerSearch: Search customers by name or phone
heldNameHint: Customer name or a short note
name: Name
productHint: Prices, batches and stock in one place.
confirmDelete: Delete this record? This action cannot be undone.
confirmClear: Clear every item from this bill?
adjustHint: Use a negative quantity to reduce stock. Select the affected batch.
backupHint: Keep a recent backup on a separate drive.
purchaseHint: Receiving goods creates costed stock batches.
returnHint: Find the original bill and select the quantities being returned.
voidHint: Select every remaining item to void the bill.
shiftHint: A simple record of your sales and returns.
noActiveShift: Start a shift before making sales
overviewHint: A clear picture of your store, without going online.
reportsHint: Sales, profit and stock, with exports you can keep.
userHint: Cashiers can bill and manage their own shift. Only the owner manages the store.
settingsHint: Make this counter work the way your shop does.
restoreConfirm: Restore this backup? Current data will be replaced. A safety copy will be saved first. You will be signed out.
integrityFailed: The database needs recovery. Choose a verified backup to restore.
noElectron: Open the desktop application to use your store database.
validation: Check the highlighted fields and try again.
invalidCredentials: The username or password is incorrect.
sessionExpired: Your screen is locked. Sign in to continue.
pinRequired: Enter the owner's 4–6 digit approval PIN.
tryLater: Too many attempts. Try again in one minute.
ownerProtected: The owner account cannot be changed here.
passwordRequired: Enter a password for the new cashier.
notFound: This record could not be found.
productUnavailable: An item is unavailable. Remove it and try again.
discountTooHigh: The discount cannot exceed the bill value.
discountLimit: This discount exceeds the cashier limit set by the owner.
pointsTooHigh: There are not enough points, or their value exceeds the bill.
insufficientStock: There is not enough unexpired stock for this quantity.
paymentMismatch: Split payments must add up to the amount due.
insufficientTender: Cash received is less than the cash payment.
referenceRequired: Enter a reference for card or bank payments.
returnQuantity: Return quantity exceeds the remaining quantity on the bill.
quantityPrecision: Use up to three decimal places for quantities.
duplicateBarcode: A barcode is already used by another product.
duplicateRecord: A record with these details already exists.
recordInUse: This record is used elsewhere and cannot be deleted.
batchRequired: Select a batch for this stock reduction.
paymentExceedsBalance: The payment exceeds the outstanding balance.
clearedChequeLocked: A cleared cheque cannot be changed or deleted.
duplicateLine: An item appears more than once.
holdCurrentCart: Hold or clear the current bill first.
shiftAlreadyOpen: You already have an open shift.
startShiftFirst: Start your shift before completing a sale.
wholeQuantity: Pieces and packs must use whole quantities.
customerRequired: Select a customer for credit or points redemption.
creditLimit: This sale would exceed the customer's credit limit.
voidAllItems: Select every remaining item to void this bill.
creditRefundLimit: This credit refund exceeds the unpaid credit balance.
refundCreditFirst: Refund the unpaid customer credit first.
invalidBackup: This is not a compatible, healthy Ajith Super Market backup.
importError: The import file is invalid. Check the template and row details.
unknownError: The action could not be completed. Try again or check the local error log.
printFailed: Printing failed. Save the receipt as PDF and try your printer again.
stockAsOf: Stock and balances reflect the current position
passwordUnchanged: Leave blank to keep the current password
negativeStockHint: This setting permits sales without available stock for the owner only.
restoreOwnerOnly: Sign in as the owner to restore a backup.
dailyAutoBackup: Automatic backup runs daily while the app is open.
passwordDifferent: Choose a different password from the current one.
catalogueHint: Choose a category, then tap an item to add it to the bill.
catalogueSearch: Search items by name, SKU or barcode
barcodeEntry: Add by barcode or item code
barcodePlaceholder: Scan or enter a barcode / SKU
imageFileHint: PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 1.5 MB.
invalidImage: This image could not be opened. Choose another image.
productImageHint: Optional. Shown in the checkout catalogue and bill items.
measurementHint: Enter the measured amount. The price is calculated automatically.
invalidMeasurement: Enter a positive amount with up to three decimal places in the product's pricing unit.
measurementDiscountHint: The bill applies any item or bill discounts after this calculation.
removeProductHint: Remove from the active catalogue? Past bills and stock records will be kept.
accountNamesHint: Change the names displayed for the owner and cashiers.
mockOverviewHint: Sample records for the past 12 months. Preview figures only; these records do not change bills or stock.
stocktakeHint: Count physical stock, review differences, then apply the count.
countReviewHint: Leave uncounted items blank. Stock changes after counting began must be reviewed in a new count.
applyCountConfirm: Apply these physical counts to stock?
countRequired: Enter at least one physical count.
stockChangedDuringCount: Stock changed after this count began. Start a new count and recount the affected items.
stocktakeCompleted: This stock count is already completed.
supplierReturnHint: Return purchased batches to suppliers and record the credit against their balance.
noReturnableBatches: No purchased stock is available to return to this supplier.
scanReceiptHint: Scan a receipt barcode or enter a bill number
switchCashierHint: Your current bill is saved to your account. Choose a cashier and enter their PIN.
cashierPinHint: Use 4–6 digits. The cashier must complete their first password change before using PIN sign-in.
noCashierPins: No cashier PINs are ready. The owner can set them in Settings after each cashier completes their first password change.
expiredStockHint: This stock has expired and cannot be added to a bill.
stockAvailabilityHint: Total stock includes expired batches. Only available, unexpired stock can be sold.
